rapport.opening_line: Hey Dave — I work with independent distributors on the treatment side. I hear you're selling Kaishan compressors but drop-shipping the dryers. I think I can fix that.
rapport.adapted_script: He's ALREADY frustrated about drop-ship margins — this call is timely. Talk to him as a distributor, never an end-user. Lead-feed and margin are the hooks; support/lead-time is the closer (it answers his backorder scar directly). Position ECOTROC KTA-S refrigerated dryers as the everyday attach on his Kaishan sales, ECOTROC DDAP desiccant as the higher-margin critical-air option, and ECOCLEAN APF filtration as the high-turn consumable pull-through. Make the treatment-attach math explicit: every compressor he already sells becomes a second, higher-margin line he OWNS. If he asks about lead time, support, or lead-feed — those are buying signals, close on them.
watch_outs: He built this himself — talk peer-to-peer, don't be pushy
The drop-ship pain is fresh — don't waste his time, get to margin + support fast
Talk distributor economics, not end-user features
SCOPE: KSI's line here is dryers and filtration ONLY — keep the recommendation to those
product_reference: ECOTROC KTA-S — refrigerated dryers, 14 to ~1,890 CFM, ~$1,880 up to ~$47,000. The everyday attach on a Kaishan sale — real margin on a line he owns instead of a drop-shipped catalog dryer.
ECOTROC DDAP — desiccant dryers for low-dewpoint / critical air. Higher ticket, higher margin, the step up when refrigerated isn't enough.
ECOCLEAN APF — coalescing + particulate filtration, ~$155 to ~$709 per housing. High-turn consumable that re-orders on a cycle — recurring margin, not a one-time sale.
German-engineered — protects his service reputation; he eats the callback when a cheap dryer fails, so reliability IS margin for him.

THE PROGRAM for Dave: carry ECOTROC + ECOCLEAN as a treatment line he owns, attach it to every Kaishan compressor package, and take KSI's qualified Midwest lead-feed + co-marketing on top. Fixes the margin gap, the lead-time scar, and the empty half of every compressor sale in one move.
